blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Assembling the store is like conducting an orchestra: each instrument can work alone, but the shared score defines order, entrances, and the response to a wrong note. Here the part you will actually inspect is an executable foundation dossier: boundary map, data model, access matrix, environment register, and four build gates; stop using the analogy if it obscures the technical boundary shown by the code.

Start by bounding this lesson’s case: milestone 1 creates the Next.js skeleton, environment contracts, Supabase schema, roles, and boundary map before decorative pages. Map browsers, server components, routes, database, and providers, then state for every boundary who authenticates, validates, stores, and observes. The term trust boundary is not a decorative label: A crossing where data changes trust level and must be validated or authorized. It determines what enters, which authority may act, and which observation counts as evidence rather than an impression.

In exercises/27-capstone/architecture.md, the example deliberately reduces the system to an executable foundation dossier: boundary map, data model, access matrix, environment register, and four build gates. Read each line as one responsibility, then run npm run build. The main failure to trigger is: components, tables, and providers are connected before deciding who authenticates and validates each mutation. It shows why the professional correction is to write the diagram, data model, RLS policies, variable register, and acceptance criteria, then build one minimal vertical slice, not to conceal the error.

In a real system, the happy path is only one case among retries, invalid input, and partial outages. The expected proof is that types, build, and migrations pass on an empty database; a visitor reads published products, a customer only their orders, and an authorized admin can prepare an audited mutation. Apply the same evidence to architecture, catalog, cart, payment, administration, communication, and operations together, using a correlation trace without secrets or personal data so both success and failure remain explainable.

- [ ] VERIFY package.json et next.config.js : versions et commandes de vérité
- [ ] VERIFY middleware.ts, lib/db-server.ts et lib/permissions.ts : session et autorisation

- [ ] MAP Browser -> Server Component -> Route Handler -> Supabase/provider
- [ ] MARK chaque frontière : authentification, validation, autorisation, stockage, journal

npm ci
npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false
npm run validate:course
npm run build
## Tests d’acceptation du jalon
- [ ] Une base vide peut être initialisée depuis les artefacts documentés
- [ ] Un visiteur ne lit que les produits publiés ; un client ne lit que ses commandes

- [ ] Les logs portent requestId et code d’erreur, jamais jeton, email ou corps de paiement
- [ ] Chaque dépendance externe possède timeout, réponse publique sûre et stratégie de reprise

# Jalon 2 — Catalogue, authentification, données et administration
## Tranche verticale à livrer
- [ ] VERIFY lib/products.ts comme source de lecture produit validée
- [ ] VERIFY app/boutique/page.tsx et app/produit/[slug]/page.tsx : liste, détail, vide, erreur
- [ ] VERIFY app/connexion/page.tsx, app/inscription/page.tsx et middleware.ts : session et retour sûr
- [ ] VERIFY app/admin/products/page.tsx et app/admin/stock/page.tsx : rôle contrôlé au serveur
- [ ] MODEL product, variant, media, price_minor, currency, stock et published_at
- [ ] RECORD actor_id, action, entity_id, before et after pour chaque mutation admin
## Commandes de vérification
npx tsc --noEmit --incremental false
npm run build
npm run dev
## Tests d’acceptation du jalon
- [ ] Un visiteur recherche et ouvre un produit publié avec prix et stock cohérents
- [ ] Un slug absent rend not-found ; une panne de données rend un état sûr et traçable
- [ ] Un client authentifié ne peut ni publier un produit ni modifier le stock par appel HTTP direct
- [ ] Un admin autorisé modifie une variante et le journal d’audit identifie la mutation
- [ ] Après mutation validée, liste, détail et recherche convergent vers la même source de vérité

blocks.title: Simple analogy
blocks.text: Assembling the store is like conducting an orchestra: each instrument can work alone, but the shared score defines order, entrances, and the response to a wrong note. Here the part you will actually inspect is a testable purchase slice connecting server authority, state machine, PayPal signature, persistent idempotency, and post-commit notifications; stop using the analogy if it obscures the technical boundary shown by the code.

Start by bounding this lesson’s case: milestone 3 covers guest or customer cart, server recalculation, stock reservation, pending order, verified PayPal capture, and post-commit notification. Recalculate price and stock on the server, create the order before the provider call, apply webhooks idempotently, and notify from a confirmed state change. The term state machine is not a decorative label: A model enumerating allowed states and the only valid transitions between them. It determines what enters, which authority may act, and which observation counts as evidence rather than an impression.

In exercises/27-capstone/purchase-payment-notifications.md, the example deliberately reduces the system to a testable purchase slice connecting server authority, state machine, PayPal signature, persistent idempotency, and post-commit notifications. Read each line as one responsibility, then run npm run build. The main failure to trigger is: the browser marks paid on PayPal return or a webhook notifies before the order-and-stock transaction commits. It shows why the professional correction is to keep authority on the server, verify and reconcile the event, lock transitions, persist idempotency, and publish effects after commit, not to conceal the error.

In a real system, the happy path is only one case among retries, invalid input, and partial outages. The expected proof is that a journey test proves success, denial, replayed webhook, and insufficient stock; no branch duplicates order, stock, capture, or message. Apply the same evidence to architecture, catalog, cart, payment, administration, communication, and operations together, using a correlation trace without secrets or personal data so both success and failure remain explainable.
